reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but rewrites the daily-skips-weekends rule that getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already encodes instead of extracting a shared occurrence-adjustment helper.

duplication.why: The isDailyWithSkippedWeekends expression and its skip-vs-move handling are copied from getNextDate, and the occurrence/try-catch/breadcrumb scaffold mirrors getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered alongside it; the weekend-adjustment decision would sit better in shared/schedules.ts with the other date rules.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Readable pipeline with a documented two-day margin, but the weekend rule now lives in two places (getNextDate and here) and a third variant in getUpcomingDates, so a change to weekend handling must be repeated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared function deciding an occurrence's final day exists to go around; getDateWithSkippedWeekend is used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied isDailyWithSkippedWeekends condition keeps the same name and shape as in getNextDate.
